_note: Weights for /beleg's crash value score. Tunable here so the ranking can be argued with without editing code — the pattern hooks/pulse-rubric.json sets.
users_exponent_criterion: Blast radius, flattened. ✓ a fault touching many distinct users outranks one touching few · ✗ raw event count, which lets a single user's retry loop out-shout a fleet-wide fault.
trend_criterion: Fresh damage outranks an old ache. ✓ first seen inside the new_within_days window reads 'new'; last seen before the fading_after_days cutoff reads 'fading' · ✗ a crash absent from recent builds ranked as though it were still landing.
version_concentration_criterion: A crash confined to the newest build is a shipped regression. ✓ every recorded version equals the latest known version · ✗ a crash spread evenly across releases treated as new breakage.
actionability_criterion: A crash you cannot reach is not worth the top slot. ✓ the blaming frame lands in first-party code · ✗ a loud fault deep in a vendor SDK ranked above a quieter one you could fix today. 'unknown' is neutral, never a penalty — the console source cannot see the frame, and absent evidence must not read as a verdict.
